name: Busa Portfolio Health
description: Read-mostly dashboard over a revenue-based-financing (RBF) fund or private-credit book of many small SME contracts: portfolio health, AUM, repayment progress, industry/city concentration risk, and a watchlist of contracts with declining revenue. The only human action — flag a contract for review, clear a flag, or leave a note — is written directly onto the contract's own record; there is no separate approval queue and no transaction path. Generic and brand-free.

agentPrompts.label: Show me the portfolio health overview
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-portfolio-health` skill in this folder, then summarize total AUM, total collected, weighted-average repayment progress, at-risk contract count, and category allocation.

agentPrompts.label: What's our concentration risk?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-portfolio-health` skill in this folder, then summarize funding-amount concentration by industry/category and by city, and flag anything that looks over-concentrated.

agentPrompts.label: Which contracts need attention this week?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-portfolio-health` skill in this folder, then list the contracts on the watchlist for a recent revenue decline or high repayment lag, ranked by severity.
